title: Kopi Rush: a kopitiam drinks game I vibe-coded with Claude for camp
summary: A playable game for mixed-age campers aged 8 to 12: read kopitiam order codes like Teh C siew dai peng and build the drink. Three modes, a self-playing 90-second demo, 11 prompts word for word, campers' bug-hunt fixes and in-page tests.
